verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party documentation on how Linear performs in workspaces with tens of thousands of issues, and none stating whether item caps apply at that scale. Community speed praise comes from small teams and hobby projects, and the only cap mentioned is a community report of a 250-issue free-plan limit, so neither addresses large-workspace behavior. API rate limits are request throttles, not item caps or workspace performance, so they do not count here.

support.subject: As an engineer, I know how the product performs and whether item caps apply in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks
